prompt: A panoramic view of a cluttered steampunk inventor's workshop. In the center, a heavy wooden workbench is covered with intricate brass gears and cogs. A large blueprint, held down by a wrench, shows a complex design. A magnifying lamp on an articulated arm illuminates a half-assembled clockwork automaton. Nearby, a pressure gauge is connected to a network of copper pipes on the wall. A leather-bound journal lies open next to a quill and an ink pot. In the corner, a small anvil and a hammer rest beside a set of bellows. A pair of worn goggles sits on top of a stack of old books. On a shelf, several test tubes and a Bunsen burner are next to a large electrical coil. A barometer hangs on the wall. The workshop is a place of metal and mechanics; you will find no plastic components or rubber tires here. This is a workshop of the past's future, so it is devoid of any digital screen, laser cutter, smartphone, or neon sign.
